reason: The README describes an external-service integration that adds ChatGPT OAuth authentication and the openai-codex model route to DeepSeek Harness, with browser/device-code login, CLI controls, token refresh, and native credential storage.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT OAuth 登录、openai-codex 模型路由以及基于系统原生凭据存储的命令行和网页配置支持。
summaries.en: Adds ChatGPT OAuth login, the openai-codex model route, and CLI and web configuration support with credentials stored in native operating-system credential stores for DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: ChatGPT OAuth sign-in through browser or device code
Integration with the DeepSeek Harness model route
Automatic OAuth token refresh and logout
Storage of OAuth credentials in native operating-system credential stores
CLI and web settings for authentication status and provider configuration
